versions.subject: Auto stash before rebase of "Neo23x0/master"
versions.detection:
condition: 1 of them
selection_cutil:
    CommandLine: 
        - '*/i:%APPDATA%\logs.txt scrobj.dll'
    Image:
        - '*\cutil.exe'
selection_regsvr32:
